title: Patipatti
text: 1.2. Sāvatthinidānaṃ || || Tatravoca || || 3. Micchāpaṭipattiñca vo bhikkhave desissāmi sammāpaṭipattiñca || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamā ca bhikkhave micchāpaṭipatti || || Seyyathīdaṃ || micchādiṭṭhi || la [pe] || micchāsamādhi || || Ayam vuccati bhikkhave micchāpaṭipatti || || 4. Katamā ca bhikkhave sammāpaṭipatti || || Seyyathīdaṃ || sammādiṭṭhi || la [pe] || sammāsamādhi || || Ayam vuccati bhikkhave sammāpaṭipattī ti || ||
